subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Permanent
solution: The correct answer is '**Ephemeral**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's take a look at the given words: • **Permanent**: lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely. • Eg. A **permanent** ban on the dumping of radioactive waste at sea is in order. • **Ephemeral**: lasting for a very short time. • Eg. **Ephemerals** avoid the periods of drought as seeds. • **Lesser**: not so great or important as the other or the rest. • Eg. He was convicted of a **lesser** assault charge • **Longer**: measuring a great distance from end to end. • Eg. The Cambridge side played the ball **longer**. • **Shorter**: measuring a small distance from end to end. • Eg. I'm visiting London for a **short** break. • From the above given meanings and examples, we can conclude that **Ephemeral** is the **ANTONYM** of **Permanent**. Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • **Permanent**: {स्थायी या रहने का इरादा या अनिश्चित काल तक अपरिवर्तित रहना।} • **Ephemeral**: {बहुत कम समय के लिए स्थायी।} • **Lesser**: {इतना महान या महत्वपूर्ण नहीं जितना कि दूसरा या बाकी।} • **Longer**: {एक छोर से दूसरे छोर तक एक बड़ी दूरी को मापना।} • **Shorter**: {एक सिरे से दूसरे छोर तक एक छोटी दूरी मापना।} 48:T5ce, The correct answer is '**There are 36 species of dolphins**'.
